clips.title: The story
paras: Bashana Runetotem is an herbalist and druidic researcher residing on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. The daughter of Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, she aids the Cenarion Circle by overseeing agricultural investigations and guiding Horde adventurers against corrupting forces.

Standing atop the breezy heights of the Elder Rise, Bashana Runetotem carries on the druidic legacy of her father, Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem. While her father guides the burgeoning tauren druids and advises Cairne Bloodhoof, Bashana focuses on practical research into botanical anomalies and regional threats. She equips travelers with tools like evergreen pouches to cultivate mysterious flora, notably the enigmatic morrowgrain, while also coordinating Horde efforts to cleanse foul corruption spreading from places like Blackfathom Deeps.
